title: Not quite what I expected
text: Not quite what I expected. These are super cute, but I was looking for something a little larger (wider) and thicker. From the picture I couldn’t really tell how thin i they were, but when they got here I realized they weren’t for me.

product_metadata.title: homing Round Placemats Set of 4 for Dining Table – Woven Heat Resistant Anti-Slid Cotton Kitchen Table Mats 14 Inch, Easy to Care, Mixed Color, Grey
features: 👍 PRACTICAL DESIGN: the stylish bright-colored circular woven hand-made table mats come in a pack of 4 to set your table or use in various places with these homey looks.
👍 HIGH QUALITY: made of 80% cotton & 20% polypropylene, free of chemicals. The size is 14 inches (36 cm) diameter, accommodate to your bowls, plates and beautiful vase for daily use.
👍 PROTECT YOUR TABLE: these placemats are heat-resistant can amount to 158 °F (70 °C), please DO NOT use it exceeds the temperature; protect your table from scratches and do not slip.
👍 LOW MAINTAIN: reusable just hand wash in warm soapy water and wipe dry; If stains stuck in the placemats, please wash it with brush; Do not wash in machine or use steel ball.

👍 GREAT HOME DECOR: the vibrant placemats as kitchen decor are good match dining table setting, hotel, patio table; available in multiple colors and designs, great for holiday, family gatherings, etc.
